doc.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: June at home with three boys during the long tours
summary: Heath explains the 88-city tour, his promises to June, moving out of the middle-income project to Queens, and credits June.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yeah, and June was home with the three boys. They kept adding on a week, and I’d call her and say, I’m coming home such-in-such a day, and then that day would approach and Monte would say, “We got a chance to do this…” and I would say, “Baby, I’m not coming home for another ten days.” I finally said, “If you add another day, you’re gonna get another bass player ‘cause I told June three times I was on the way home.” They weren’t married at that time in the 50s and I was. We had this family with her alone. Of course, we had moved out of this Harlem River Drive Apartments ‘cause the Quartet had started making too much money. My salary was too much to be in a middle-income project like that. I told them for years, “Look, half of my expenses on the road… this is not really my income. This is my net.” And finally they said, “Mr. Heath, you make too much money,” so that’s when I bought the house out in Queens.
In Springfield Gardens, close to the airport. I could drive in the back door of Kennedy airport in fifteen minutes…

Jason was born in… He’s 45 so he was born in ‘56, I guess. She had the three boys in ’57 without me. That extensive tour was really… she believed in this music so much that she just gave me to the world. That lady you just met, June, when I see the in 40th anniversary compilation, that box set, and June Heath is not mentioned, it galls me because before Mrs. Lewis and Mrs. Jackson were even on the scene, Mrs. Heath was behind all of that.

She . . . had me to come home to her and the family before any influence that those other ladies had later and they’re given credit for in the notes on that thing. And I said, “How could they leave June out?”
